Thanks. I'll own the streaming / real-time inference work on the Redwood side. Below is a proposed task breakdown and owners for the Integration Build Plan milestone. I'll upload the full runbook to the shared Drive post-kickoff.

Redwood implementation tasks (streaming, SDK, tool-calling, structured outputs):

1) SDK integration (Redwood-side support)- Task: Produce SDK examples (JavaScript, Python) and client-side quickstart- Owner: Jordan Blake- Deliverable: SDK samples repo + quickstart snippet- Target: 2027-04-20

2) Streaming & performance (KV cache, batching, latency SLOs)- Task: Define recommended batching strategy, KV cache warmup, and perf test plan- Owner: Dev Patel- Deliverable: streaming runbook excerpt + perf window notes- Target: 2027-04-22

3) Tool calling & verification flow- Task: Provide reference webhooks and verification patterns (idempotency, retries)- Owner: Ben Carter (SE)- Deliverable: tool-calling guide + sample webhook handlers- Target: 2027-04-24

4) Structured outputs (schema, validators, regression tests)- Task: Draft JSON schema for outputs and test harness for validation- Owner: Marissa Cole- Deliverable: schema file + validation test suite- Target: 2027-04-25

5) End-to-end acceptance & regression checklist- Task: Coordinate acceptance tests with Acme QA and run regression suite- Owner: Acme QA lead (Noah to nominate) + Marissa- Deliverable: signed acceptance checklist- Target: 2027-05-12

Dependencies & notes:
- Need sandbox credentials and sample payloads from Acme by 2027-04-08 to hit the timeline
- Procurement/SOW sign-off needs visibility - Ben to follow up with procurement contact
- We should plan a short perf window (2 days) in late April for latency/cost tuning

Attachments to follow: redwood-implementation-checklist.md (checklist), link to shared Drive runbook (will post after kickoff)

I'll prepare the streaming runbook excerpt and push to the Drive by 4/06 so Acme infra has something to read before the kickoff.
